title: SmartScope Preprocessing Manifest
description: Sent by SmartScope to the compute function via the manifest JSON file. Describes a batch of movies to preprocess.

batch_id.description: Unique identifier for this batch (used for output filenames).

movies.description: Movie file paths relative to project_dir.

config.description: Processing parameters. Compute functions should use these to configure their pipeline.

project_dir.description: Absolute path to the project directory on the HPC.

dose_per_frame.description: Electron dose per frame in e/A^2.

gain_reference.description: Gain reference filename (in project root). Empty if none.

gain_flip.description: Gain reference flip (0 or 1, RELION convention).

thumbnail_destinations.description: Map of movie filename -> Globus destination paths for thumbnails. The compute function uses these in its transfer_items to route thumbnails directly to where SmartScope expects them.

png.description: Globus path for the micrograph thumbnail.

ctf.description: Globus path for the CTF thumbnail.
